{{Quote|Czerka Corporation has a prototype technology that can detect Imperial starships at twice the distance of typical scanners. [...] All we ask is that you destroy the prototypes, destroy the labs and preferably kill every team leader who's ever heard of the project.|Lieutenant [[DeMare]]|<ref name="TOR:Prototype" />}}
The '''Czerka Labs''' was a research facility operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-contracted company [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was located in the [[Republic Research Division]] of the [[Ternion Building]].<ref name="TOR:Prototype" />
